rationales: E-mail is short for electronic mail.
Electrical mail is not the expansion of e-mail.
Electronic medium is not the expansion of e-mail.
Electronic message is not the standard expansion of e-mail.
One component is insufficient for a communication system.
Three is fewer than the basic components typically identified for a communication system.
The five basic components are sender, receiver, message, medium, and protocol.
Six is not the standard count of basic communication-system components.
An IPv4 address does not contain 31 bits.
An IPv4 address does not contain 29 bits.
An IPv4 address contains 32 binary bits.
An IPv4 address does not contain 30 bits.
Hacking refers to unauthorized access or interference, not specifically illegal copying of software.
Illegal copying or distribution of software is called piracy.
Counterfeiting means making or selling fake goods or documents.
Sabotage means deliberately damaging or disrupting something.
A key may unlock something but is not the usual authentication credential for system access.
Piracy is illegal copying or distribution, not an authentication method.
A patent grants intellectual-property rights and is not used to authenticate a user.
A password is used to authenticate a user when entering a system.
The body element contains the page's visible content, not its metadata container.
The head element contains document metadata.
The title element specifies the page title, not the metadata container as a whole.
The html element is the root element containing the entire HTML document.
The br tag inserts a line break.
The hr tag creates a thematic break, commonly shown as a horizontal rule.
The u tag underlines text.
The b tag makes text bold.
Act it out means to perform or demonstrate something, not describe an unplanned solution.
A candid solution refers to a spontaneous, unplanned response.
A prototype is an early model or version of a product.
To guess means to estimate without enough information, not specifically to act spontaneously.
10000 in binary equals 16, not 17.
10110 in binary equals 22, not 17.
10001 in binary equals 17.
101000 in binary equals 40, not 17.
A simple proposition expresses one proposition rather than combining several.
A mixed proposition is not the standard term for a proposition formed by combining propositions.
A compound proposition combines two or more propositions.
A full proposition is not the standard term for combining propositions.
The bold tag is written <b>, not <bold>.
<bd> is not the HTML tag for bold text.

A prepared solution is planned rather than reached without planning.
A candid solution is spontaneous and not reached through proper algorithms or work planning.
A strategized solution is developed through planning.
A best solution is selected after considering possible solutions, not defined by lack of planning.
A flowchart visually represents steps but is not itself the set of steps.
An algorithm is a set of steps for solving a problem.
A guess is an estimate, not an ordered procedure.
A prototype is an early model or version, not a set of solution steps.
Using the customary binary convention, 1 KB equals 1024 bytes, not 1000.
Eight is the number of bits in a byte, not the number of bytes in a kilobyte.

Four is not the number of bytes in a kilobyte.
